## Cognition model

The cognition model has 1 general cognitive factor (GCP) measured by the 8 tests (@fig-pmm-model). Each test is also regressed on the `r n_cov_terms` sociodemographic terms (3 age spline terms, female sex, Black or African American race, Hispanic ethnicity, years of schooling, and two-way interactions among them), with the coefficients fixed at the values estimated in the robust norms group; these terms adjust the test scores and do not predict class. Class membership changes the mean and variance of the factor and the thresholds of self-rated memory. The Normal class sets the scale of the factor (mean 0, variance 1), and the means and variances in the MCI and Dementia classes are estimated relative to it. The loadings, intercepts, thresholds, and residual variances of the 8 tests are equal across classes, so the tests inform class membership only through the factor. Within each class the tests correlate through the factor, as they do in the robust norms group, and the residual covariances among the 3 continuous scores (animal naming, delayed word recall, and number series) are fixed at 0. The 5 categorical tests (orientation to date, object naming, naming the President and Vice President, serial 7 subtraction, and backward counting) and self-rated memory are ordinal indicators with logit thresholds, and the model is estimated by numerical integration over the factor.

```{r}
source(here::here("R", "PMM_090_model_registry.R"))
source(here::here("R", "PMM_101_mplus_function.R"))

class_names <- c("Normal", "MCI", "Dementia")

pmm_cog_cal <- suppressWarnings(MplusAutomation::readModels(pmm_models$cognition$calibration_out, what = "summaries"))
pmm_cog_parameters <- pmm_h5_parameter_table(mplush5::mplus.print.model.results(pmm_models$cognition$calibration_h5))
pmm_cog_stdyx <- pmm_h5_parameter_table(mplush5::mplus.print.standardized.model.results(
  pmm_models$cognition$calibration_h5, stype = "stdyx"))

# Parameter estimates by class, as "estimate (SE)"; fixed parameters marked.
pmm_par_by_class <- function(par, header_regex) {
  par |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl(header_regex, paramHeader),
                  LatentClass %in% c("1", "2", "3")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      class = factor(LatentClass, levels = c("1", "2", "3"), labels = class_names),
      value = dplyr::if_else(est_se == 999,
                             sprintf("%.3f (fixed)", est),
                             sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", est, se))
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(paramHeader, param),
                       names_from = class, values_from = value) |>
    dplyr::mutate(paramHeader = stringr::str_replace(paramHeader, "\\.", " "))
}

pmm_fit_row <- function(mod, label) {
  s <- mod[["summaries"]]
  tibble::tibble(
    Model = label,
    N = s[["Observations"]],
    `Free parameters` = s[["Parameters"]],
    Loglikelihood = s[["LL"]],
    BIC = s[["BIC"]]
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Cognition model: sample and fit (known-class calibration)"
pmm_fit_row(pmm_cog_cal, pmm_models$cognition$label) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(Loglikelihood, BIC), decimals = 1) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = N, decimals = 0)
```

### Parameter estimates

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Factor loadings, unstandardized, estimate (SE)"
pmm_par_by_class(pmm_cog_parameters, "\\.BY$") |>
  gt::gt()
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Factor loadings, standardized (STDYX), estimate (SE)"
pmm_par_by_class(pmm_cog_stdyx, "\\.BY$") |>
  gt::gt()
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "General cognitive factor: mean and variance by class, estimate (SE)"
pmm_par_by_class(pmm_cog_parameters, "^Means$|^Variances$") |>
  gt::gt()
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Intercepts and thresholds by class, estimate (SE)"
pmm_par_by_class(pmm_cog_parameters, "^Intercepts$|^Thresholds$") |>
  gt::gt()
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Residual variances of the continuous scores by class, estimate (SE)"
pmm_par_by_class(pmm_cog_parameters, "^Residual\\.Variances$") |>
  gt::gt()
```

### Class probabilities

```{r}
pmm_labels <- readRDS(here::here("R_objects", "PMM_100.RDS")) |>
  dplyr::filter(inHCAP == 1) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    id = as.numeric(id),
    algorithmic = factor(as.integer(haven::zap_labels(vs1hcapdxeap)),
                         levels = 1:3, labels = class_names)
  )

pmm_read_cprob <- function(path) {
  suppressWarnings(MplusAutomation::readModels(path))[["savedata"]] |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    janitor::clean_names() |>
    dplyr::transmute(id = as.numeric(id), cprob1, cprob2, cprob3)
}

pmm_cprob_plot <- function(cprob) {
  joined <- dplyr::inner_join(cprob, pmm_labels, by = "id")
  if (nrow(joined) != nrow(cprob)) {
    stop("Class probabilities for ", nrow(cprob) - nrow(joined),
         " participants have no HRS/HCAP Algorithm class.")
  }
  joined |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(cprob1, cprob2, cprob3), names_to = "class", values_to = "prob") |>
    dplyr::mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c("cprob1", "cprob2", "cprob3"),
                                 labels = stringr::str_c("P(", class_names, ")"))) |>
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = prob, y = algorithmic)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(class ~ .) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous("Class probability") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete("HRS/HCAP Algorithm class") +
    hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum()
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Cognition model: class probabilities by HRS/HCAP Algorithm class (unweighted)"
pmm_cprob_plot(pmm_read_cprob(pmm_models$cognition$scoring_out))
```
